changelog:
Initial release of disk-space-analyzer.

- Automatically scans all disk drives and generates detailed reports on disk usage.
- Identifies top space-consuming directories and traces the root cause of disk full issues.
- Lists safe-to-clean caches and temporary files, including estimated space savings.
- Provides actionable optimization suggestions, prioritizing the most effective actions.
- HTML report includes visual breakdowns and trace paths for top culprits.
- Handles edge cases such as permission-denied drives or limited scan results.
